dependency_coverage.name: Bool
dependency_coverage.meaning: The two-element type with values false and true.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Each B i is a Boolean-valued random variable, and the random sum counts indices whose value is true.

dependency_coverage.name: Bool.instMeasurableSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: The top, hence discrete, measurable space on Bool, in which every subset is measurable.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the codomain measurable structure for the measurability, law, and independence assertions about the Boolean variables.

dependency_coverage.name: Bool.true
dependency_coverage.meaning: The true value of the Boolean type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Designates success: the ith summand in the observed count is 1 exactly when B i omega is true.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the division operation from a division-inverse monoid structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies real division in the positive base (e * sum_i p_i) / t of the real power.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Propositional equality between two values of the same type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Tests whether B i omega equals true in the indicator defining the success count.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite sum of a function over a finite set in an additive commutative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms both the total parameter sum sum_i p_i and the observed real success count sum_i 1_{B_i(omega)=true}.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite set containing every element of a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes all displayed sums range over every index i in the finite type ι.

dependency_coverage.name: Fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: A type equipped with a finite enumeration of all its elements.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Restricts the Bernoulli family to finitely many indices while allowing any finite index type.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The division operation selected by a heterogeneous-division instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets (e * sum_i p_i) / t as ordinary real division.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplication operation selected by a heterogeneous-multiplication instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Realizes e times the total parameter and the product of exp(-sum_i p_i) with the real power as ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: The power operation selected by a heterogeneous-power instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Raises the positive real base (e * sum_i p_i) / t to the real exponent t using real power semantics.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: The less-than-or-equal relation supplied by an LE instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Expresses p_i <= 1, the inclusive event sum_i 1_{B_i=true} <= t, and the final probability upper bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The strict-less-than relation supplied by an LT instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Expresses the strict threshold conditions 0 < t and t < sum_i p_i.

dependency_coverage.name: Measurable
dependency_coverage.meaning: A function is measurable when the preimage of every measurable codomain set is measurable in its domain.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Requires each Boolean random variable B i to be measurable from Ω to discrete Bool.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasurableSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: A sigma-algebra of measurable subsets on a type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Allows Ω to be an arbitrary measurable sample space and supplies the structure needed by μ and the random variables.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure
dependency_coverage.meaning: The property that a measure has total mass one.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Requires μ to be a probability measure, so the real measure of the lower-tail event is an ordinary finite probability.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.Measure
dependency_coverage.meaning: A countably additive extended-nonnegative-real-valued measure on a measurable space.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the measure μ governing the distributions and independence and measuring the lower-tail event.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.Measure.real
dependency_coverage.meaning: Evaluates a measure on a set and converts its extended nonnegative real value to a real number.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the left side the real probability under μ of the event that the observed success count is at most t.

dependency_coverage.name: NNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real numbers equipped with a proof of nonnegativity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes each p i nonnegative by type, while hp imposes the additional upper bound p i <= 1.

dependency_coverage.name: NNReal.toReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection from a nonnegative real to its underlying real value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Embeds each p i into the real total parameter appearing in the threshold hypothesis and probability bound.

dependency_coverage.name: Neg.neg
dependency_coverage.meaning: The unary negation operation supplied by a Neg instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms the exponent -sum_i p_i in the leading exponential factor.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets a natural-number literal in a target type through its OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the constants 0 and 1 in the real and nonnegative-real contexts.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: Builds interpretation of the numeral one from a type's one element.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the upper parameter bound 1, the true-indicator value 1, and the argument 1 in exp(1) = e.

dependency_coverage.name: PMF.bernoulli
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a nonnegative p with p <= 1, the probability mass function on Bool assigning mass p to true and 1 - p to false.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Specifies the Bernoulli success probability p i for each Boolean random variable B i.

dependency_coverage.name: PMF.toMeasure
dependency_coverage.meaning: Converts a probability mass function on a measurable type into its corresponding probability measure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Presents each Bernoulli probability mass function as the measure used in the HasLaw hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: PartialOrder.toPreorder
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets antisymmetry from a partial order to obtain its underlying preorder.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Participates in obtaining the order used by p i <= 1 on nonnegative reals.

dependency_coverage.name: Preorder.toLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the non-strict order relation from a preorder.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the <= relation in each nonnegative-real parameter condition p i <= 1.

dependency_coverage.name: ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw
dependency_coverage.meaning: The assertion that a random variable under a source measure has a specified measure as its distribution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Requires each B i under μ to have the Boolean Bernoulli law with parameter p i.

dependency_coverage.name: ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
dependency_coverage.meaning: The indexed family of random functions is mutually independent with respect to the given measure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Requires the whole finite family (B i) to be mutually independent under μ, not merely pairwise independent.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Is the number system for t, parameter and indicator sums, exponentials, division, real powers, converted probability, and inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.exp
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real exponential function x maps to e^x.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms exp(-sum_i p_i), and exp(1) supplies the constant e in the power base.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard additive commutative monoid structure on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes both finite sums ordinary real sums, with empty sum equal to zero.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instDivInvMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard multiplicative, inverse, and totalized division structure on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines the quotient (e * sum_i p_i) / t; the hypothesis t > 0 makes its denominator nonzero and the quotient ordinary positive division.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard less-than-or-equal ordering on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the inclusive event and final probability bound in the usual real order.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLT
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard strict ordering on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets 0 < t < sum_i p_i as strict real inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard multiplication operation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes e times the total parameter and the product of the exponential with the power ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNeg
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard additive negation operation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the minus sign in exp(-sum_i p_i).

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative identity one in the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the success-indicator value 1 and the argument 1 of exp(1), so that exp(1) is e.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Real exponentiation with a real base and real exponent, implemented by Real.rpow.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes ((e * sum_i p_i) / t)^t a real power with real exponent t, not a natural-number repeated product.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive identity zero in the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies zero in the strict positivity hypothesis 0 < t and the false-indicator value 0.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: Builds interpretation of the numeral zero from a type's zero element.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the real zeros used in 0 < t and in the Boolean success indicator.

dependency_coverage.name: instDecidableEqBool
dependency_coverage.meaning: A decision procedure for equality of Boolean values.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Allows the conditional expression to decide whether B i omega equals true, without adding a probabilistic assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: instHDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Promotes homogeneous division on a type to the heterogeneous-division interface.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Routes the displayed quotient to ordinary real division and adds no proposition-level content.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Promotes homogeneous multiplication on a type to the heterogeneous-multiplication interface.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Routes the displayed products to ordinary real multiplication and adds no proposition-level content.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Promotes a power operation to the heterogeneous-power interface.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Routes the real base and real exponent t to Real.rpow.

dependency_coverage.name: instOneNNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The element one in the nonnegative real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the upper endpoint 1 in each parameter condition p i <= 1.

dependency_coverage.name: instPartialOrderNNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard partial order on nonnegative reals inherited from the real-number order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Ensures p i <= 1 is the usual numeric upper bound on each Bernoulli parameter.

dependency_coverage.name: ite
dependency_coverage.meaning: A conditional expression equal to its first value when the proposition is true and its second value otherwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines each real success indicator as 1 when B i omega is true and 0 otherwise.

dependency_coverage.name: setOf
dependency_coverage.meaning: Set comprehension: setOf P is the set of elements satisfying predicate P.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Builds the event of sample points omega for which the observed success count is at most t.

binders: ι is an arbitrary finite type of indices.
Ω is an arbitrary type equipped with a measurable-space structure.
μ is an arbitrary probability measure on Ω.
B is an arbitrary indexed family of Boolean-valued functions B_i : Ω -> Bool.
p is an arbitrary indexed family of nonnegative real parameters p_i.
t is an arbitrary real threshold (an implicit universally quantified binder).
hypotheses: For every index i, p_i <= 1; because p_i is a nonnegative real by type, 0 <= p_i <= 1.
The entire family (B_i) is mutually independent under μ.
For every i, B_i has under μ the Boolean Bernoulli law assigning probability p_i to true and 1 - p_i to false.
For every i, B_i is measurable into the discrete measurable space on Bool.
The real threshold satisfies 0 < t < sum_i p_i.
conclusions: The real probability of the inclusive event {omega | sum_i 1_{B_i(omega)=true} <= t} is at most exp(-sum_i p_i) * ((e * sum_i p_i) / t)^t.
The exponent t on the final factor is a real exponent interpreted by Real.rpow.
mathematical_definitions: X(omega) = sum_i 1_{B_i(omega)=true} is the real-valued number of true outcomes in the finite family.
S = sum_i p_i is the real sum of the Bernoulli success parameters.
The lower-tail event is {X <= t}; equality at the real threshold t is included.
The Bernoulli law on Bool puts mass p_i at true and mass 1 - p_i at false.
exp(1) is e, and ((e S) / t)^t denotes the real power Real.rpow because both the base and exponent are real.
μ.real converts the finite extended-nonnegative measure of the event to its ordinary real probability.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every finite family of mutually independent measurable Bernoulli Boolean random variables with possibly different success probabilities p_i, and every real t strictly between 0 and the total parameter S = sum_i p_i, the probability that the number of successes is at most t is bounded above by exp(-S) times ((e S) / t) raised to the real power t.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The indexed family must be finite, but the variables need not be identically distributed.
Each p_i may be 0 or 1; its only parameter restriction is 0 <= p_i <= 1.
The threshold t is real, not necessarily an integer, and is restricted by the strict inequalities 0 < t < S where S = sum_i p_i.
The event is inclusive, X <= t. Since X is integer-valued but t is real, its actual membership depends on which natural counts lie below the real threshold; no floor operation is explicitly encoded.
The final power is Real.rpow with real exponent t, not natural exponentiation.
The hypotheses imply S > 0 and t > 0, so the quotient (e S) / t has a positive, nonzero denominator and a positive base.
If the index type is empty or all p_i are zero, then S = 0 and no real t can satisfy 0 < t < S; in those cases the implication is vacuously true.
Only this lower-tail event is bounded; no upper-tail, two-sided, equality, optimality, or matching lower-bound statement is encoded.
